name: roster-grant
title: Roster Grant
description: Three rows of roster cards stream past a call to action, a pointer walks in and clicks it, and the monograms start turning to the accent one every seven frames — top row, middle, bottom, top, bottom, middle, so it reads as a system granting rather than a list iterating. The camera and the middle row's clearance around the pill settle on the same measured exponential; the outer rows deliberately do not, which is what stops the two sides ever looking symmetric.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/roster-grant?ref=cli — pass rows as three arrays of { name, role } and label for the button.
